about: Screens of the web sheets that are NOT shown outside this machine: most of what they show was written or photographed by users (posts, listings, reviews, nicknames), or by small businesses and individuals. Judged screen by screen on the 390 and the 1440 first viewport, 2026-11-21, by the main session; the owner has been shown the list (report card 11) and has not yet decided on publication. mark-withheld.mjs writes these into each sheet's screens.json as `withheld: <reason>` on every width of the key; the site's reader and the mock generators leave such records out. A blocked screen (403) is not listed here: it has no image at all.
